Request is scene-without-placementRoom plus subject; activeRequest additionally depends on scenePhase. Frame publication does not change those inputs. .task(id:) performs one debounce/render/publication sequence and guards cancellation. Renderer is an actor; Metal waits there. Opening Projects is not an explicit cancellation input, but this finite retained-mode work is not selected by the failing method and does not establish the timeout cause.

Naming stores a single UUID when the user action creates the request; the sheet item is not regenerated on each body. ProjectLibraryView is not keyed by Studio's generation. Scene generation changes at operation adoption, not at Duplicate menu selection. Render and inspector child IDs change only with their captured ownership/generation.

Duplicate menu only assigns Naming. Domain duplicate/store I/O begins on ProjectNameEditor submission. The prior create's parent task completes after adoption clears pending; its child observer then dismisses. No repeated save task or new busy/progress state is started at the recorded Duplicate menu boundary.

Library appearance/disappearance can change acceptingImports/cancel import; those values do not mount/unmount the naming sheet or mutate scene. Plan gesture finish is guarded by an active drag. Inspector slider display sync is nonanimated, equality-guarded and does not open an edit without a tracking token. No closed state feedback path was established.

Name editor focus is local state. The bridge coalesces focus work and does not schedule itself again from its synchronization callback; synchronization does not call rendering or parent library commands. Actual repeated-sheet teardown/first-responder ordering remains unobserved.

observations.classification: causal exclusion for the recorded method
observations.statement: The proposed Study/Metal background loop does not have an activation edge in this required workflow.
observations.causal_path: KeyAndFillApp.WindowGroup -> StudioView(mode='Plan') -> Plan Canvas/markers. Test lines46-80 never select another mode. StudioView lines531-540 construct ReferenceStudyPreview only for Study and native previews only for Camera/3D. Parent create adoption can reset mode to Plan (line1437), never to Study.
observations.limit: Source/test path inference; no runtime mode trace was captured. This is not a claim that all framework internals were idle.

observations.statement: The library uses static top-view Canvas thumbnails, not Study renders; Plan's receiving preferences have no demonstrated self-sustaining invalidation cycle.
observations.causal_path: ProjectLibraryView.projectRowLabel -> ProjectLibraryThumbnail.Snapshot -> finite Canvas draw, no @State/tasks. Studio Plan GeometryReader -> grid title and notice preferences -> equality-guarded receiving states. Those receiving states alter labels outside a fixed-height diagram, not scene, mode or renderer request.
observations.limit: Modal/keyboard layout can still cause framework-driven geometry updates. No runtime preference counts or layout trace exists to show an oscillation.

observations.classification: finite render lifecycle outside actual path
observations.statement: When Study is selected in another workflow, presenting Projects is not an explicit render pause, but frame completion cannot itself alter the task identity.
observations.causal_path: activeRequest(scenePhase, Request(scene minus placementRoom, subject)) -> .task(id:) ->80ms sleep -> StudyRenderEngine actor -> one frame write. Frame is absent from Request and activeRequest. Scene-generation .id changes cancel/recreate the view; inactive scenePhase produces nil request. No callback returns an image into scene or parent library state.
observations.limit: A currently selected Study may finish a bounded in-flight render behind a sheet while the app remains active. This observation alone is neither a defect nor an explanation for the Plan-mode failure.

observations.statement: Duplicate presentation starts with a new stored Naming identity and no duplicate storage operation.
observations.causal_path: Menu Duplicate -> naming = Naming(kind:.duplicate(project.id), initial:'Editorial copy') -> .sheet(item:$naming) -> ProjectNameEditor(local name/focused/isSubmitting). Only submit calls apply(.duplicate), reserves parent, and starts store work. Body reevaluation does not regenerate Naming.id; parent scene generation is independent of this naming selection.
observations.limit: The log proves an event was synthesized, not that the app action executed or that the new sheet completed presentation.

observations.statement: The completed create operation can invalidate the underlying Studio once, but the source does not keep a saving spinner or operation pending at the subsequent unsubmitted Duplicate step.
observations.causal_path: Create submit -> reserve pending -> store.perform await -> adopt/finish clears pending -> publish library/scene/saved; reset selection/history/presentation if switching -> child task resumes -> dismiss -> isSubmitting=false. No loop feeds completion back into reserve. isPerformingOperation is used by other perform() paths, not naming submit.
observations.limit: Sheet/keyboard dismissal completion is not logged. Calling dismiss before clearing isSubmitting is a lifecycle boundary to observe, not a proven cause.

observations.statement: The original failed-query diagnostic contains the first entered value Editorial rather than Duplicate's expected Editorial copy. Its geometry is invalid throughout the window path.
observations.causal_path: Duplicate event -> idle/animation notification timeout -> field existence query -> diagnostic snapshot request. Diagnostic text reports projectNameInput, value Editorial, Keyboard Focused; the main window and all listed framed ancestors are {{inf, inf}, {0.0, 0.0}}.
observations.interpretation: This discrepancy justifies tracing old/new Naming identity and editor lifecycle. It may be stale or query-failure data; it cannot prove that the old field remained live, that the second sheet was absent, or that a real field was zero-sized/offscreen. There is no modal title/full hierarchy/usable rectangle in this text.

next_discriminating_evidence: Keep the original required test/assertions and recorded failure. Inspect the original recording/full hierarchy if accessible to determine actual sheet, menu and keyboard state; this worker has not done that.

During one bounded reproduction, record view mode plus Naming UUID/kind, sheet onAppear/onDisappear/onDismiss completion, old/new field lifecycle/window/first-responder transitions, and parent operation adoption/finish. Avoid logging entered name text.

Capture an app main-thread sample during the first idle timeout using a host path that does not depend on a successful AX snapshot. This distinguishes app layout/presentation work from stalled automation services.

If background invalidation remains a hypothesis, count Plan preference changes and Study render starts/completions around the boundary. The source-path prediction for this method is zero Study requests and stable Plan preferences after layout settles.

A controlled first-menu naming sheet versus Create-then-menu sheet comparison can separate menu presentation from repeated-editor lifecycle. Any diagnostic variant supplements the unchanged end-to-end acceptance method.
change_recommendation: No production patch is supported by this review alone. Pausing Study on showProjects, changing render cache/task identity, increasing the input timeout, or changing field IDs would not address an established cause. Resolve the modal/main-thread evidence before selecting a correction.
